verdict.rationale: Clerk documents its own OAuth implementation, letting third-party apps request scoped access, plus custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients. It also offers a standards-based device authorization grant and OIDC for Enterprise SSO, so developers get managed OAuth/OIDC flows without writing protocol code. However, the specific flows named in the story are not evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit authorization-code-with-PKCE support, documented refresh-token issuance and rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the OAuth/OIDC flows.
